terbaru.judul: A Density-Delay Law for Stable Event-Driven State Progression in Open Distributed Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper derives a density-delay law for such exclusive state progression processes.

terbaru.judul: Deanonymizing Bitcoin Transactions via Network Traffic Analysis with Semi-supervised Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose \textit{NTSSL}, a novel and efficient transaction deanonymization method that integrates network traffic analysis with semi-supervised learning.

terbaru.judul: A Depth-Aware Comparative Study of Euclidean and Hyperbolic Graph Neural Networks on Bitcoin Transaction Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: By explicitly varying the neighborhood while keeping the model architecture and dimensionality fixed, we analyze the differences in two embedding spaces.

terbaru.judul: Algorithmic Compliance and Regulatory Loss in Digital Assets
terbaru.pelajaran: We study the deployment performance of machine learning based enforcement systems used in cryptocurrency anti money laundering (AML).

terbaru.judul: Towards Accurate and Interpretable Time-series Forecasting: A Polynomial Learning Approach
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes the interpretable polynomial learning (IPL) method, which integrates interpretability into the model structure by explicitly modeling original features and their interactions of arbitrary order through polynomial representations.

terbaru.judul: A402: Binding Cryptocurrency Payments to Service Execution for Agentic Commerce
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we present A402, a trust-minimized payment architecture that securely binds cryptocurrency payments to service execution.

terbaru.judul: TAS-GNN: A Status-Aware Signed Graph Neural Network for Anomaly Detection in Bitcoin Trust Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose TAS-GNN (Topology-Aware Signed Graph Neural Network), a novel framework designed for feature-sparse signed networks like Bitcoin-Alpha.

terbaru.judul: One Rising Ship Sinks Other Ships: Cross-Chain Negative Spillovers in Crypto Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: Using on-chain data from Ethereum, Solana, Binance Smart Chain, Arbitrum, and Avalanche (2022-2025), we show that surges on one chain often coincide with declines on others, in contrast to the positive co-movements typical of equity markets.

terbaru.judul: Normalisation and Initialisation Strategies for Graph Neural Networks in Blockchain Anomaly Detection
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a systematic ablation of initialisation and normalisation strategies across three GNN architectures (GCN, GAT, and GraphSAGE) on the Elliptic Bitcoin dataset.

terbaru.judul: Stability Anchors and Risk Amplifiers: Tail Spillovers Across Stablecoin Designs
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper investigates systemic risk transmission across stablecoin markets using Quantile Vector Autoregression (QVAR).
